leadText:
N's hideout is an -exclusive location in the Unova region. It is located in a secret forest that appears to be in a separate dimension.
 
After was injured trying to save Pokémon from Team Plasma's control device in Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!, Anthea and Concordia appeared from within a strange blanket of fog and rescued N from Team Plasma, while , , and followed. They brought him to the hideout and healed him in a small pond nearby. Although Anthea and Concordia demanded Ash and his friends to leave, N permitted them to stay.

N revealed that he, Anthea, and Concordia took up residence in the secret cottage two years earlier after their previous home was destroyed by when Ghetsis tried to control it. Since then, they have lived at the cottage, taking care of Pokémon who were injured due to the carelessness of humans.

The trio would later be forced to abandon the hideout once Team Plasma was able to locate it and attack in hopes of capturing N.
